## Mixed Berry — G4 *Friendship is Magic*

**Who she is:** A mint-turquoise Earth-pony mare in Sire’s Hollow, recognizable by her purple bob, huge violet eyes, pink-and-purple striped outfit, and ever-present smoothie. She is a tiny background sight gag in **“The Parent Map”** (season 8, episode 8; aired May 5, 2018), seen twice enjoying a drink while Starlight Glimmer and Sunburst visit their parents.

**Name:** “Mixed Berry” is the name used by background-pony catalogs and a 2019 Equestria Daily feature. It suits her smoothie habit, but I found no production credit, script, toy, or creator confirmation establishing it as an official character name; the original namer is unverified.

**Voice and appearances:** No verified spoken lines or individual voice credit. Her reliably documented television appearance is **“The Parent Map”**; no separate comic, film appearance, alternate identity, or visible cutie mark was verified.
